csv_project_name: Master Study for Columbus Trails & Sidewalks
csv_scope_of_work: Columbus Consolidated Government (the City ) and the Columbus-Phenix City Transportation Study (CPCMPO) are requesting proposals for a Consultant Team to perform a study that will assess the current state of trails and sidewalks throughout the city to identify areas for improvement, ways to enhance connectivity and add additional trails/sidewalks, and evaluate the safety of existing facilities.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Feasibility Studies, Planning/Master Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
csv_comments: ' *** Time Sensitive *** - Project Number: 26-0005- Project Funding: IIJA $1,000,000.0- Solicitation documents available online.
title: Master Study for Columbus Trails & Sidewalks
short_description: Consulting study for citywide trail and sidewalk assessment, connectivity improvements, and safety evaluation.
project_scope: Citywide master study assessing the current condition of trails and sidewalks in Columbus, identifying improvement areas, enhancing connectivity, proposing additional trails and sidewalks, and evaluating safety of existing facilities.
services: Consultant team services for civil engineering, feasibility studies, planning/master planning, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, transportation planning, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a planning/master study, not a structural or bridge design project.
- Scope focuses on trails, sidewalks, connectivity, and safety assessment rather than engineering of a specific structure.
- Falls under pure urban/open space planning and feasibility/planning services, which are not targeted for sbp.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building component is indicated.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The documents only mention project funding of 1000000 USD for the study/procurement context, not construction works.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. The source only indicates overall project funding of 1000000 USD and does not define a design fee or engineering budget.
references_qualifications: Consultant team requested with disciplines including civil engineering, feasibility studies, planning/master planning, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, transportation planning, and urban studies/planning/design. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
